{{nihongo|'''Nōgō Hakusan Shrine'''|能郷白山神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Mino Province]].

'''Nōgō Hakusan Shrine''' (のうごうはくさんじんじゃ) is a Shinto shrine located in Neo Nōgō, Motosu City, Gifu Prefecture. Its {{ill|Okumiya|ja|奥宮|qid=Q11445659}} is situated at the summit of {{ill|Mount Nōgōhaku|Q6922468|qid=Q6922468}} (elevation 1,617.3 m). Originally, the Okumiya served as the main sanctuary, but the present main shrine was later constructed for the convenience of local residents.

=== Enshrined deities ===
* {{ill|Kikurihime|Q11619891|qid=Q11619891}} (Hakusan-hime no Kami / {{ill|Hakusan Gongen|Q11579578|qid=Q11579578}})
* {{ill|Izanagi|abstract|Q813858|ar|إزاناغي|az|İzanaqi|bcl|Izanagi|bn|ইজানাগি|bs|Izanagi|ca|Izanagi|cs|Izanagi a Izanami|da|Izanagi|el|Ιζανάγκι|eo|Izanagi|es|Izanagi|fa|ایزاناگی|fi|Izanaki|fr|Izanagi|he|איזאנגי|hr|Izanagi|hu|Izanagi|id|Izanagi|it|Izanagi|ja|イザナギ|ka|იძანაგი|ko|이자나기|lt|Idzanagis|mk|Изанаги|mni|ꯏꯓꯥꯅꯥꯒꯤ|no|Izanagi|or|ଇଜାନାଗି|pt|Izanagi|ro|Izanagi|rsk|Изанаґи|ru|Идзанаги|simple|Izanagi|sk|Izanagi|sl|Izanagi|sr|Изанаки|sv|Izanagi|ta|இசநாகி|th|อิซานางิ|tl|Izanagi|tr|İzanagi|uk|Ідзанаґі|vi|Izanagi|zh|伊邪那岐|qid=Q813858|lt=Izanagi no Mikoto}}
* {{ill|Izanami|Q682306|qid=Q682306|lt=Izanami no Mikoto}}

=== History ===
According to tradition, the shrine was founded in {{ill|Yōrō|de|Yōrō (Ära)|es|Yōrō|fa|یورو (دوره)|fr|Ère Yōrō|ia|Yoro|id|Yōrō|it|Yōrō (era)|ja|養老|ko|요로 (연호)|ru|Ёро (нэнго)|simple|Yōrō|sr|Јоро|tr|Yōrō|uk|Йоро (ненґо)|zh|養老 (日本)|zh_yue|養老|qid=Q1373061}} 2 ({{ill|718|ab|718|af|718|am|718 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|718|ar|718|ary|718|ast|718|az|718|azb|۷۱۸ (میلادی)|be|718|be_x_old|718|bg|718|bn|৭১৮|bpy|মারি ৭১৮|br|718|bs|718.|ca|718|cdo|718 nièng|ceb|718|ckb|٧١٨|crh|718|cs|718|cv|718|cy|718|da|718|de|718|el|718|eml|718|eo|718|es|718|et|718|eu|718|fa|۷۱۸ (میلادی)|fi|718|fo|718|fr|718|fy|718|ga|718|gan|718年|gd|718|gl|718|he|718|hi|718|hr|718.|ht|718 (almanak jilyen)|hu|718|hy|718|id|718|ilo|718|io|718|is|718|it|718|ja|718年|jv|718|ka|718|kaa|718|kk|718 жыл|ko|718년|la|718|lb|718|lij|718|lmo|718|lt|718 m.|map_bms|718|mdf|718|mg|718|mhr|718|mk|718|mr|इ.स. ७१८|mrj|718 и|ms|718|mzn|۷۱۸|nah|718|nap|718|nds|718|new|सन् ७१८|nl|718|nn|718|no|718|nrm|718|nso|718|oc|718|or|୭୧୮|os|718-æм аз|pl|718|pnb|718|pt|718|qu|718|ro|718|ru|718 год|rue|718|sa|७१८|scn|718|sd|718ع|sh|718.|shn|718|si|718|sk|718|sl|718|smn|718|sq|718|sr|718|su|718|sv|718|sw|718|tg|Соли 718|th|พ.ศ. 1261|tk|718|tl|718|tly|718|tr|718|tt|718 ел|uk|718|ur|718ء|uz|718|vec|718|vi|718|war|718|wuu|718年|xmf|718|zh|718年|zh_min_nan|718 nî|zh_yue|718年|qid=Q23534}}) when {{ill|Taichō|de|Taichō|fr|Taichō|it|Taichō|ja|泰澄|qid=Q2388439}} transferred the deity from {{ill|Shirayama Hime Shrine|Q704702|qid=Q704702}} in {{ill|Kaga Province|Q907469|qid=Q907469}}. It is said to be one of the “Seven Hakusan Shrines of Hokuriku” (another of these shrines is {{ill|Ōyama Hakusan Shrine|Q11434667|qid=Q11434667}}). At the time of its founding, it was called “Hakusan Myōri Gongen,” and it is said that {{ill|Ākāśagarbha|Q416174|qid=Q416174}}, {{ill|Ekādaśamukha|Q11404731|qid=Q11404731|lt=Jūichimen Kanzeon Bosatsu}}, and {{ill|Āryāvalokiteśvara|Q124684411|qid=Q124684411|lt=Shō Kanzeon Bosatsu}} were enshrined.

In June of {{ill|Meiji era|Q3125096|qid=Q3125096}} 6 ({{ill|1873|Q7757|qid=Q7757}}), it was ranked as a {{ill|Gō-sha|ja|郷社|qid=Q134917316}}. In Meiji 30 ({{ill|1897|Q7847|qid=Q7847}}), the present shrine buildings were rebuilt, and in {{ill|Heisei era|Q234510|qid=Q234510}} 19 ({{ill|2007|Q2024|qid=Q2024}}), the main sanctuary underwent restoration.

=== Festivals and rites ===
At the annual festival held on April 13, {{ill|Nōgō no Noh and Kyōgen|ja|能郷の能・狂言|qid=Q11612074}} are performed.

=== Shrine buildings ===
The current main hall dates from the reconstruction of Meiji 30.

=== Access ===
; Main shrine
* The nearest public transportation is about 10 km from {{ill|Tarumi Station (Gifu)|de|Bahnhof Tarumi (Gifu)|id|Stasiun Tarumi (Gifu)|ja|樽見駅|jv|Setatsiyun Tarumi (Gifu)|ko|다루미역 (기후현)|zh|樽見站|qid=Q7686918}} on the {{ill|Tarumi Line|de|Tarumi-Linie|fr|Ligne Tarumi|it|Linea Tarumi|ja|樽見鉄道樽見線|ko|다루미 철도 다루미선|zh|樽見線|qid=Q7686917}} of {{ill|Tarumi Railway|de|Tarumi Tetsudō|fr|Tarumi Railway|it|Ferrovia Tarumi|ja|樽見鉄道|zh|樽見鐵道|qid=Q11543718}}.
* Take the Motosu City Bus Nōgō Line and get off at the “Nōgō” bus stop; about a 5-minute walk.

=== Other ===
